mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task (task_id, requested_model_id, model_id, status) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{requestedModelId}, #{modelId}, 'QUEUED')
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, requested_model_id, model_id, status, trace_id, error_code, error_message, created_time, started_time, finished_time FROM agent_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE agent_task SET status = 'REJECTED', error_code = 'TASK_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED', error_message = '任务执行器暂时无法接收请求，请稍后重试', finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE agent_task SET status = #{status}, trace_id = #{traceId}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED')
